title: Up Beat Textures
description: Up Beat Textures is a modern and clean Texture pack designed for Minecraft versions 1.20 to 1.21. Its clean and simple with a new style!
body:
**Up Beat Textures is a modern, clean, and simple resource pack designed to enhance your gameplay while maintaining the charming essence of Minecraft. Perfect for players who appreciate a fresh aesthetic, this pack features vibrant colors, smooth textures, and a minimalistic design that brings a new level of clarity to your world.**

Features:
Modern Aesthetic: Enjoy a sleek and contemporary look that revitalizes your Minecraft environment.
Clean Textures: Each texture is crafted with precision, ensuring a polished appearance without overwhelming detail.
Simplified Designs: Focus on the beauty of Minecraft's core elements with simplified textures that enhance visibility and style.
Wide Compatibility: Up Beat Textures supports Minecraft versions from 1.20 to 1.21, ensuring a smooth experience for all players.

**[Up Beat Textures on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/up-beat-textures)**



Enjoy :)
